caption:
Retatrutide — the molecule everyone in fitness is talking about 🧪 It acts on three hormone receptors at once (GLP-1, GIP and glucagon). It is still in clinical trials and not approved anywhere; online “research” products are not the manufacturer's drug. And weight lost is not all fat — trials track body composition, not just kilograms.

Educational content, not medical advice. More at pepsafe.info

scenes.say: Hi! I'm a peptide, a short chain of amino acids.
Everyone in fitness is talking about my cousin, retatrutide.
It switches on three hormone receptors at once.
But it's still in trials, and not approved anywhere.
And weight lost isn't all fat. Scientists track muscle too.
Weight isn't the whole story. More at pepsafe dot info.
